claim: Dihedral-HSP hardware demonstration (labeled engineering artifact): the dihedral-HSP procedure — coset-state preparation + one Kuperberg sieve combination (CNOT + herald) — realized on IBM ibm_fez recovers the hidden shift s. Payload: N=8 all 8 shifts x 3 bits + N=16 all 16 shifts x low bit, each bit read by majority vote on herald-kept shots. Engineering demonstration (the non-abelian coset counterpart to F113's abelian 2D-HLF solver), NOT a quantum-vs-classical advantage claim.

_billing_values.unit: one estimator: the majority-vote bit = 1[ P(measure 1 on the sieved control, X-basis, herald-kept) > 0.5 ], applied identically to every (N,s,bit) circuit
_billing_values.stopping_rule: fixed 20,000 shots per circuit, frozen in the prereg before submit, identical for all 40 circuits; herald post-selection keeps ~50% (one sieve round), applied identically
_billing_values.rejected_convention: no cross-unit conversion arises: there is no classical arm and no ratio. All circuits are one population-vote estimator on the same pinned layout with the same shot count.
_billing_values.baseline_note: there is NO baseline arm and NO ratio. Small-N brute force over N shifts is classically trivial (N=8: instant) — which is precisely why no advantage is or can be claimed. The demonstration is graded solely by whether the quantum machinery recovers s on hardware.

advantage_claimed: none — engineering artifact; recovering a small-N hidden shift is classically trivial. Graded only by hardware recovery of s against the pre-registered falsifiers; the value is a non-abelian-HSP capability datapoint, not a speedup.
_planted_structure_leak_check: N/A to an advantage — but stated because F121 is why this frame exists: the hidden shift IS compiled into the coset states and DOES leak to a trivial classical query. That would kill an ADVANTAGE claim; it does not touch a DEMONSTRATION claim, which asserts only that the quantum procedure runs and recovers s. No advantage is claimed, so the leak is not a defect here — it is the reason the ceiling is honestly stated as 'no advantage'.
_index_space_check: Mechanical check: the 40 circuits are keyed by NAMED tuples (N,s,bit); each graded bit is a fixed majority vote on ONE named control qubit's herald-kept counts with NO argmin/argmax/first-match/scan-order tie-break. find_pair is deterministic (first (a,b) in fixed nested-range order satisfying a+b=k or a-b=k) and its output is FROZEN into the circuits before submit, not re-derived at grade time. Permuting the payload list or the counts dict moves no graded number. Backend and layout are PINNED by name (no least-busy scan). Both keys 'no'.
